scope: The root read all 48 complete scene/question/answer/explanation triples in six explicit batches; original approved source senses and scene text are unchanged. Approval binds these exact question hashes only.
presentationRequired: Show only Chinese meaning/POS/letter-count and the cloze before the English recall is locked.
Do not reveal target-bearing titles, complete scenes, explanations or evidence before that response is retained.
Reveal target English and full scene for subsequent meaning/POS assisted consolidation.
Only explicit English-recall failure independently creates a memory lapse; meaning/POS errors still require correction but are not independent forgetting or generalisation measurements.
Preserve original responses, genuine correction evidence, source hashes and owner/generation boundaries. Pending and missing data are neither pass nor fail.
specialCasesReviewed: low: rent and bus fare use the broad low-amount sense, without copying the old pay referent.
rate: breathing frequency and blood-flow rate do not inherit the old heart-rate referent.
less: sugar/paper are uncountable amounts; fewer is not the taught target.
economic: economy-related differs from economical, which usually means economical/avoiding waste.
perhaps/probably: Chinese meaning plus 7/8-letter cue defines the learned lexical target; a non-target response must not be presented as a general grammatical impossibility.
Several/actually/probably: sentence-position capitalization is explained; no new inflected source occurrence is created.
